name: notion-skills
description: Use a Notion database as your personal, agent-agnostic skill store. Register skills as Notion pages (name + trigger keywords + instructions); a SessionStart hook injects a compact index of them into each session and routes matching requests to the right page. Syncing calls the Notion API with your own Notion credentials — no other network access and no telemetry. Notion AI and other agents consume the same skills directly.
